error[ZC-E0212]: the store database does not exist
  cause  Postgres at 127.0.0.1 has no database named zcube
  fix    create the database, or correct its name in the store settings
  more   zcube explain E0212 · rerun with --verbose for the full cause chain
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigcube/errors/E0212.html
